state.ready: Everything is in place: {{universe}} is fully operational.
state.notReady: {{universe}} is not fully operational yet: a few things below are missing.
state.unknown: Part of {{universe}} could not be checked.
state.tabsLeft: {{universe}} works, but a step is left: {{tabs}}.

badge.label: Not ready ({{count}})
badge.tooltip: {{universe}} is not fully operational — open Ready to start

sidecars.title: Extensions
sidecars.hint: Each extension's status, from the universe's config check.
sidecars.error: The config check could not be read: {{error}}

programs.title: Programs to install
programs.hint: The programs the extensions need on this machine, installed in your own profile (no administrator rights unless said).
programs.optionalHint: Not needed to start; tick one to install it.
programs.elevation: {{programs}} need administrator rights: Windows asks once, for all of them together.
programs.installing: Installing {{programs}}… this can take a few minutes.
programs.installingOne: Installing… this may take a few minutes.
programs.reportHint: Everything known about the failure: the command that ran, its exit code and what it means, all it printed. Copy gives it as text, ready to paste into an assistant.
programs.notInstalledHint: A universe uses these extensions, but their files are no longer on this computer: reinstall them.
programs.error: The programs could not be planned: {{error}}
programs.intro: Install the programs the universe needs on this computer: « Install all » is usually enough.
programs.notFoundAfterInstall: Installed, but not found: the check looked for {{what}} on this computer’s PATH, read again after the install, and in the folders where npm and bun put their commands. Check again, or follow the install guide.
programs.notFoundAfterInstallPackage: Installed, but not found: the check did not find the Python package {{what}} in the Python pip installed it with. Check again, or follow the install guide.
programs.adminTip: This program installs for the whole computer: the system asks for administrator rights once, for all the programs that need them.

keys.title: Keys
keys.hint: The keys the extensions need: your team's key sets first, then the keys still missing.
keys.passwordHint: {{solution}} provides sealed key sets. Enter the team password once: it opens them all.
keys.skipPassword: I don't have the password — enter the keys by hand
keys.formHint: Fill them in and save: each goes where its scope says (this universe, or every universe).
keys.error: The keys could not be read: {{error}}
keys.intro: Import the keys your team gave you: they open the online services the universe needs.
keys.fileHint: Did your team give you a keys file? Choose it, then enter its password.

profile.intro: Say who you are and where your work is saved: it signs your work and keeps it in the right place.
profile.whoHint: Your name and e-mail appear on what you produce.
profile.folderTitle: Where this universe's work is created
profile.folderHint: This universe’s project folder: your first work is created there. You can choose another one.
profile.noFolder: No project folder is chosen yet.
profile.guideHint: A guided tour of the universe, when you are ready.
profile.done: Your profile and your folder are in place.
profile.error: The profile could not be read: {{error}}
profile.folderError: The project folder could not be read: {{error}}
profile.projectsFolderHint: Every project of yours lives there, outside KaTyoti's installation: an update or an uninstall never touches it.
profile.projectsFolderError: Your projects folder could not be read: {{error}}

earlier.title: Projects from your earlier installations
earlier.hint: KaTyoti found projects that an earlier installation on this computer uses. Pick the ones to bring here: each is copied into your projects folder and brought up to date on the copy - the original is never changed.
earlier.error: The earlier installations could not be read: {{error}}

installations.title: Your earlier installations
installations.hint: Earlier installations of KaTyoti on this computer. You can delete the ones you no longer use to free space; the most recent one is kept unless you untick it. Your projects in your projects folder are never deleted.
installations.stays: Its universes, their history and its settings go with it; your projects in your projects folder stay.
installations.ack: I understand that all of this will be deleted
installations.error: The installations could not be read: {{error}}

refused.current: This is the installation you are using: it cannot be deleted from here.
refused.projects-inside: Your projects folder is inside it: move your projects out first.
refused.shared: It shares a folder with another installation: delete it by hand.
